title: Dismantling the Stoquastic Dichotomy
summary: We challenge the notion that a stoquastic binary governs fundamental computational boundaries in quantum computing and classical simulation of quantum systems. We argue that vanishing geometric phase (VGP), a geometric condition on the Hamiltonian's transition graph, more adequately captures these boundaries. To distinguish VGP from stoquasticity, we construct VGP 3-local Hamiltonians that are formally hard to stoquastize, yet belong to a family admitting polynomial-time recognition of the VGP property.
